name: Hyperbolic
short: Decentralized AI cloud offering OpenAI-compatible serverless LLM inference and on-demand GPU clusters with a default free account tier.

plans.name: Free Tier
plans.notes: Default plan on signup ($0/mo, no deposit required). Generates an OpenAI-compatible API key for testing serverless inference in your own environment (capped at 60 RPM; GPU/storage launches disabled).

plans.name: Pro Tier
plans.notes: Unlocked by depositing ≥$5 in prepaid compute credits. Raises API rate limits to 600 RPM and unlocks on-demand GPU instances and storage volumes.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom SLAs, dedicated compute clusters, and unlimited API rate limits.
